author: Vikeacccq

title: So simple, yet so powerful
body: I’ve tried many habit trackers, but ever since using Habitica things have really skyrocketed. If you’re into rpg games and the “grind” somewhat motivates you, this is the app for you. It counts your streaks, it’s fun, yet simple and not distracting, and there are days when you’re not in the mood to do your thing, but your tiny character is there as a constant reminder that you’re actually doing progress, no matter how small. Great job guys, keep up the good work and thanks for everything!
author: UrbanKenshi

title: Amazing app for task scheduling
body: Amazing app for task scheduling, planning, tracking behaviors and habbits and so much more. A gamification of the regular organizers that people carry around with them.
author: Steve Smith 22

title: Not for everyone
body: Aldo is an original idea, this app is not for everyone. If you get easy frustrated than this app is not for you. It focus on the goal and not the steps you put into to achieve the goal. You get punished by not achieving your dailies and that can creates frustration. I also don't see how it help really to build positive habits and get rid of the bad habits.
